_about: One stored scan, read by BOTH test suites: msas-system/tests/Feature/CanonicalDiagnosisParityTest.php checks the API returns `api` for `record`+`location` and that the web history and report show every `mustDisplay` string; mobile/app/diagnosis/__tests__/canonicalParity.test.js renders `api` in the app and checks the same strings. A field change that only one client handles breaks one of the two tests. Since the consensus-screen fixes the farmer sees plain words (no Latin names or jargon such as 'lesions'); the technical originals are staff-only (`technical`) and in the PDF appendix. `mustNotDisplay` is checked on the web history page, the farmer part of the PDF and the app.
